patterns.note: Main content is presented in a single, centered column with a fixed maximum width, ensuring readability across various screen sizes.
A consistent sans-serif typeface is used throughout, maintaining a clear hierarchy with moderate size and weight variations for headings, body text, and metadata.
The design relies on a high-contrast black-on-white color scheme for primary content, with a distinct full-width black footer section.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Related articles are displayed in a list format, each with a small square thumbnail image aligned to the right of the text.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that remains visible at the top of the screen, allowing continuous access to navigation and actions. Beyond this, content scrolls into view without additional scroll-triggered animations or reveals.
Content is presented within a constrained, centered column, providing ample whitespace on either side for focus and readability.
A full-width, solid black background is used to visually separate the site-wide footer and subscription call-to-action from the main article content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Balanced, with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger and bolder than body text, and metadata is smaller.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for all interactive elements, content containers, and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with generous line height for body text and clear vertical separation between content blocks, creating an airy feel within sections but a standard density overall.

standout: The design is exceptionally minimal, prioritizing content readability with a stark black-on-white aesthetic. Its distinction lies in the almost complete absence of decorative UI elements, making the article content and its hero image the sole visual focus.
